alignment_note: Saved benchmark rows are joined on the exact target_date. Labels agree with the saved FINDER results on every shared date. No date shift or interpolation is applied.
threshold_note: All models use sequential F1 thresholds from earlier resolved observations on common evaluation dates. Date filters preserve the saved thresholds.
standardization_note: The optional paper display uses z = (value - mean) / std_ddof0, with each model and market's saved full-period score mean and population standard deviation. Apply the same constants to that model's score and alert threshold; do not recenter filtered dates.
